credits.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
credits.overview: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

credits.title: The incredible summer of Jesús
credits.overview: Jesús, a lonely elderly (interpreted by Jesús, the great-uncle of the director), discovers that his brother, whom he hasn't seen in twenty years, is sick and nearing death. To make amends for the mistakes of his past, he will have to initiate an adventure against Mexican bureaucracy.

credits.title: El Rey del Mañana
credits.overview: Nacho’s quiet life changes radically when his eccentric neighbor, Don Guillermo, asks him for help to prove that “someone” visits him at night. Diving into Guillermo’s troubled past and driven by his own curiosity, Nacho finds himself drawn into a series of strange events that take him to the brink of the inexplicable.

credits.title: Bad Actor
credits.overview: During the filming of a movie, actress Sandra Navarro denounces actor Daniel Zavala for sexual abuse on the set during the recording of a scene for the movie. Daniel pleads his innocence and the production tries to prevent the situation from leaking off the set and causing a scandal.

credits.title: ¿Quieres ser mi hijo?
credits.overview: Lu, a conformist woman in her forties, learns that her 15-year partner has been having extramarital affairs. Starting from scratch, she gets involved in an unexpected relationship with a young womanizer.

credits.title: 50 or Two Whales Meet at the Beach
credits.overview: Félix, a 17-year-old boy, receives an invitation on WhatsApp: do you want to play the Blue Whale Game? The one with the 50 challenges? The one where you have to kill yourself at the end? Félix accepts. That is how he meets Elisa. They start completing the challenges together.

credits.title: The End of the Beginning
credits.overview: Nadia is a hard-working professional diver. As she prepares for her very last competition, a major disappointment in her relationship leads her to discover who she is beyond her career.

credits.title: This Is Tomas
credits.overview: Leo and his band decide to bring Thomas to play in a wedding. They have no idea how complex it is to spend a day with someone with autism.

credits.title: Stormmaker
credits.overview: Romero, a retired fisherman and a forgotten hero by the community, lives isolated in his home, surrounded by ghosts of the life he couldn't have, spirits that materialize before him as his real family. credits.title: The Last Veil
credits.overview: Citliali, a lonely woman, faces a difficult, marginalized life, which seems to be full of obstacles. During the day we will discover the real cause of her affliction.
